candidates.summary: Silverstrand are seeking a Site Engineer for a variety of different civil projects across Brisbane to Gold Coast.
key_lines: Silverstrand is currently looking for a suitably qualified Site Engineer for an immediate start on a large rail project located in South Brisbane.
The successful candidate must have the following qualifications/ experience:
- Degree in Engineering or Construction Management or similar;
- Minimum of 2 years' onsite experience;
- Prior experience in an infrastructure or construction role;
- Experience with SWMS, ITP's and quality documentation;
- Ensuring compliance with safety & site environmental requirements;
- Problem solving in relation to civil and structural requirements;
Must be willing to travel.
If you believe you have the necessary experience and qualifications for this position, please forward a cover letter and your CV to employment@silverstrand.com.au.
